# Vendored Three.js modules

`GLTFLoader.js` and `BufferGeometryUtils.js` are copied from the Three.js
`0.163.0` examples distribution to match the repository's r163 runtime. Their
bare `three` imports were changed to the local `three.module.js` path.

- Source: `https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r163/examples/jsm`
- License: MIT
